text_block_list.text:
All the other Umamusume had dreams. For 
Symboli Kris S, it was the development of 
the racing world and giving back to the 
Symboli family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City seeks romance. Neo Universe 
seeks "LUZF" (mystery).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Would Hishi Miracle be able to find a 
dream of her own in this race?
